name: Eye of the One Translator (Assamite Sorcery Ritual, Level One)

system.description:
This spell is of limited physical power, but mighty potential: it assists the sorcerer in deciphering any written material upon which it is cast. Many viziers learn the basics of sorcery just to use this ritual. It does not change the page itself, but creates an illusion of the writing flowing into a form familiar to the caster.

System: The sorcerer cuts himself along the left eyebrow and lets three drops of blood (no Blood Trait cost) fall upon the page, then meditates for 10 minutes as the blood soaks in and vanishes. The player gains extra dice on all rolls to translate, decode, or comprehend the work equal to the successes rolled when casting the ritual. These extra dice are lost if work is interrupted for more than 10 minutes, or at night's end. The ritual must be cast separately for every page or surface to be translated.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two: Saracens
